people.name: Ahaz
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jotham

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For Yahweh brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel, because he acted without restraint in Judah and trespassed severely against Yahweh.
translations.bsb: For the LORD humbled Judah because Ahaz king of Israel had thrown off restraint in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the LORD.
translations.kjv: For the LORD brought ➔ Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made ➔ Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.
translations.asv: For Jehovah brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he had dealt wantonly in Judah, and trespassed sore against Jehovah.
